drums.tags: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, overdriven electric guitar riff. The guitar utilizes a palm-muted, syncopated rhythmic pattern centered around a low E pedal tone. A second electric guitar provides sustained power chords and occasional melodic fills with a high-gain, saturated tone. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a gritty, distorted timbre. The drum kit features a dry, punchy snare on beats 2 and 4, a heavy kick drum playing a syncopated pattern, and consistent eighth-note hi-hat hits. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of E minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[palm-muted electric guitar riff enters]
[syncopated kick drum and hi-hat enter]

[Main Riff]
[distorted bass guitar enters, doubling the guitar rhythm]
[snare drum enters on beats 2 and 4]
[second electric guitar enters with sustained power chords]

[Bridge]
[guitar riff becomes more open with less palm muting]
[crash cymbal accents]

[Outro]
[sustained guitar feedback]
[final kick drum hit]

bass.tags: Indie rock with surf and garage influences. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing a repetitive, syncopated riff with light spring reverb. A second electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and occasional melodic counterpoints. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a driving eighth-note pattern. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with prominent hi-hat accents and frequent snare rolls. The tempo is 120 BPM in the key of G major. The production is dry with minimal processing, emphasizing a raw, live-band aesthetic.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[clean electric guitar riff with spring reverb]
[hi-hat count-in]

[Main Theme]
[bass guitar and drums enter]
[syncopated guitar melody]

[Bridge]
[guitar switches to rhythmic chord stabs]
[snare drum rolls]

[Outro]
[guitar riff repeats and fades]
